extra.description:
不安は、自己責任にしておくと都合がいい。
たとえ、人からうつったものでも。

アスファルトに咲いた花を見て、誰かが「綺麗だ」と言う。自分にはそう見えない。
何人も同じことを言っていると、花よりも、それを綺麗だと思えない自分のほうが気になってくる。

スマホの画面には、知らなければ欲しくならなかったものが次々と流れてくる。
誰かの日常を眺めているだけなのに、気づけば自分の日常を採点している。

それで疲れると、「他人の目なんて気にするな」と言われる。
気にする理由はいくらでも勝手に増えていくのに、気にしない努力だけは、一人でしなければならない。

items.title: Cd47 deficiency in mouse brain under excitotoxic stress
items.title_zh: 兴奋性毒性应激下小鼠大脑中Cd47的缺失
items.summary_zh: CD47是一种具有明确免疫和神经发育作用的跨膜蛋白，最近被鉴定为人类、非人灵长类和小鼠中丰富的突触前蛋白。为研究Cd47如何影响神经元应激和损伤，我们对暴露于惊厥剂量（KA25；25 mg/kg）或亚惊厥剂量（KA3；3 mg/kg）海人藻酸（KA）的野生型（WT）和Cd47敲除（KO）小鼠海马进行了单核RNA测序。将细胞类型注释与加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）相结合，揭示了不同的神经元和胶质基因模块，其共表达结构因基因型和KA暴露而异。值得注意的是，某些模块仅在Cd47缺陷细胞中显示出与KA相关的共表达结构变化。这些模块的富集分析突出了翻译、生物能量和突触基因集。使用Wasserstein距离比较全转录组分布表明，在所有十五个成对比较中，载体处理的KO细胞最接近暴露于KA3的WT细胞。这些发现表明，Cd47缺失使海马转录组向类似轻度兴奋性毒性应激的状态转变，暗示Cd47是神经元应激

extra.description: CD47, a transmembrane protein with well-established immune and neurodevelopmental roles, was recently identified as an abundant presynaptic protein in humans, non-human primates, and mice. To investigate how Cd47 influences neuronal stress and injury, we performed single-nucleus RNA sequencing of hippocampi from wild-type (WT) and Cd47 knockout (KO) mice exposed to kainic acid (KA) at convulsive (KA25; 25 mg/kg) or subconvulsive (KA3; 3 mg/kg) doses. Integrating cell-type annotations with Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) revealed distinct neuronal and glial gene modules whose co-expression structure differed by genotype and by KA exposure. Notably, certain modules showed KA-associated changes in co-expression structure only in Cd47 -deficient cells. Enrichment analyses of these modules highlighted translational, bioenergetic, and synaptic gene sets. Comparing transcriptome-wide distributions using Wasserstein distance demonstrated that vehicle-treated KO cells most closely resembled WT cells exposed to KA3, of all fifteen pairwise comparisons. These findings suggest that Cd47 loss shifts the hippocampal transcriptome toward a state resembling mild excitotoxic stress, implicating Cd47 as a candidate regulator of neuronal stress adaptation and providing a hypothesis for testing that role.

items.title: SeekRBP: Leveraging Sequence-Structure Integration with Reinforcement Learning for Receptor-Binding Protein Identification.
items.title_zh: SeekRBP：利用序列-结构整合与强化学习识别受体结合蛋白。
items.summary_zh: 受体结合蛋白（RBP）启动病毒感染并决定宿主特异性，是噬菌体工程和治疗的关键靶点。然而，RBP的识别因其极端序列多样性而复杂化，这往往使传统的基于同源比对的方​​法失效。虽然机器学习提供了有前景的替代方案，但此类方法难以应对严重的类别不平衡以及从异质尾部蛋白中选择信息量大的负样本的困难。现有方法往往无法在从这些“困难负样本”中学习与保持泛化能力之间取得平衡。我们提出SeekRBP，一个序列-结构框架，将负采样建模为序贯决策问题。通过采用多臂老虎机策略，SeekRBP基于实时训练反馈动态优先选择信息量大的非RBP序列，并辅以蛋白质语言和结构嵌入的多模态融合。基准测试表明，SeekRBP始终优于静态采样策略。此外，一项针对弧菌噬菌体的案例研究验证了SeekRBP能有效识别RBP以改善宿主预测，凸显其在大规模注释和合成生物学应用中的潜力。SeekRBP的源代码可通过以下地址获取：https://

extra.description: Receptor-binding proteins (RBPs) initiate viral infection and determine host specificity, serving as key targets for phage engineering and therapy. However, the identification of RBPs is complicated by their extreme sequence divergence, which often renders traditional homology-based alignment methods ineffective. While machine learning offers a promising alternative, such approaches struggle with severe class imbalance and the difficulty of selecting informative negative samples from heterogeneous tail proteins. Existing methods often fail to balance learning from these "hard negatives" while maintaining generalization. We present SeekRBP, a sequence-structure framework that models negative sampling as a sequential decision-making problem. By employing a multi-armed bandit strategy, SeekRBP dynamically prioritizes informative non-RBP sequences based on real-time training feedback, complemented by a multimodal fusion of protein language and structural embeddings. Benchmarking demonstrates that SeekRBP consistently outperforms static sampling strategies. Furthermore, a case study on Vibrio phages validates that SeekRBP effectively identifies RBPs to improve host prediction, highlighting its potential for large-scale annotation and synthetic biology applications. The source code of SeekRBP is available via: https://github.com/Saillxl/SeekRBP.

items.summary_zh: 三维染色质相互作用在基因调控中起重要作用，然而多种相互作用类型的计算预测在很大程度上仍依赖于专门的单任务模型。在这里，我们提出UniLoopNet，一个多任务深度学习框架，可从DNA序列预测多种类型的染色质相互作用，包括增强子-启动子相互作用、增强子-增强子相互作用、CTCF介导的环和条纹相关相互作用。UniLoopNet采用共享编码器-解码器架构和分层适应策略，基于任务语义相似性整合多任务、迁移和持续学习。跨多个细胞系的全面基准测试表明，UniLoopNet优于现有的专门和多任务方法，大多数任务的AUROC超过0.90。在严格评估设置下，包括染色体匹配、距离匹配、现实不平衡和位点不相交测试，AUROC范围为0.8934至0.9366。在现实的1:5类别不平衡设置中，增强子-启动子和增强子-增强子相互作用预测的AUPRC分别为0.7956和0.6935。跨细胞系迁移实验进一步表明，将Uni

extra.description: Three-dimensional chromatin interactions play essential roles in gene regulation, yet computational prediction of diverse interaction types remains largely dependent on specialized, single-task models. Here, we present UniLoopNet, a multi-task deep learning framework that predicts multiple types of chromatin interactions including enhancer–promoter interactions, enhancer–enhancer interactions, CTCF-mediated loops, and stripe-associated interactions from DNA sequences. UniLoopNet employs a shared encoder–decoder architecture with hierarchical adaptation strategies, integrating multi-task, transfer, and continual learning based on task semantic similarity. Comprehensive benchmarking across multiple cell lines demonstrates that UniLoopNet outperforms existing specialized and multi-task approaches, with AUROCs exceeding 0.90 in most tasks. Under stringent evaluation settings, including chromosome-matched, distance-matched, realistic imbalanced, and locus-disjoint tests, AUROCs range from 0.8934 to 0.9366. In the realistic 1:5 class-imbalance setting, the AUPRCs for enhancer–promoter and enhancer–enhancer interaction prediction are 0.7956 and 0.6935, respectively. Cross-cell-line transfer experiments further show that applying UniLoopNet to another cell line requires adaptation by supervised fine-tuning on target-cell-line data, after which performance is comparable to that of within-cell-line training. Notably, the framework exhibits data efficiency in experiments with substantially reduced training data. Interpretability analyses reveal that the learned sequence features are associated with known transcription factor binding sites and uncover differential regulatory effects of disease-associated variants. UniLoopNet provides a versatile and data-efficient framework for sequence-based prediction and interpretation of diverse 3D genome interactions, complementing existing sequence-to-map approaches while improving the understanding of sequence-encoded regulatory potential.

items.title: AutoFFinder: A reconfigurable hardware-accelerated platform for multi-guide CRISPR/Cas9 off-target search.
items.title_zh: AutoFFinder：一个可重构的硬件加速平台，用于多向导CRISPR/Cas9脱靶搜索。
items.summary_zh: CRISPR/Cas9技术彻底改变了基因组编辑，但确保其安全性需要全基因组识别所有潜在脱靶位点（OTS），即与靶向位点相似度在编辑距离阈值以内的位点。现有计算方法可以扫描大型基因组至给定编辑距离阈值，但在扩展到多个向导RNA（gRNA）或高编辑距离时，面临严重的计算瓶颈，包括吞吐量低、CPU利用率欠佳和内存耗尽。在此，我们提出AutoFFinder，一个运行时可重构、软硬件协同设计的平台，用于多gRNA CRISPR/Cas9 OTS搜索。AutoFFinder结合了高通量Levenshtein自动机FPGA覆盖层（ReLev），可流式处理基因组数据以同时评估多达128个gRNA，以及一个并行CPU阶段，在多种错配和凸起约束下重建精确比对。重要的是，ReLev支持运行时更新gRNA序列和编辑距离阈值，使最终用户无需FPGA工具链专业知识即可使用该平台，并克服了以往FPGA实现的刚性——那些

extra.description: CRISPR/Cas9 technology has revolutionized genome editing, but ensuring its safety requires genome-wide identification of all potential off-target sites (OTSs), defined as sites similar to the on-target site up to an edit-distance threshold. Existing computational methods can scan large genomes up to a given edit-distance threshold, but they face severe computational bottlenecks, including low throughput, sub-optimal CPU utilization, and memory exhaustion, when scaling to multiple guide RNAs (gRNAs) or to high edit distances. Here, we present AutoFFinder, a runtime-reconfigurable, hardware-software co-designed platform for multi-gRNA CRISPR/Cas9 OTS search. AutoFFinder combines a high-throughput Levenshtein automata FPGA overlay (ReLev), which streams genomic data to evaluate up to 128 gRNAs concurrently, with a parallel CPU stage that reconstructs exact alignments under versatile mismatch and bulge constraints. Importantly, ReLev supports runtime updates to both the gRNA sequences and the edit-distance threshold, allowing end users to use the platform without FPGA toolchain expertise and overcoming the rigidity of previous FPGA implementations, which required full hardware recompilation to change patterns or thresholds. Benchmarking on the human reference genome (hg38) showed that, for 128 gRNAs at an edit-distance threshold of 6, AutoFFinder completed an end-to-end search in 68.43 seconds (1.14 minutes), compared with 190.62 seconds (3.18 minutes) by a GPU-based Myers' Bitparallel algorithm and 38.0-38.7 minutes by applicable state-of-the-art CPU-based methods. In addition, AutoFFinder is guaranteed to recover all potential OTSs as demonstrated in a separate completeness validation. In summary, AutoFFinder provides a highly scalable, FPGA-accelerated solution for rigorous CRISPR design workflows. The source code for AutoFFinder is publicly available at https://github.com/OrensteinLab/AutoFFinder. is available on Bioinformatics online.

items.title: DTBNet: Multimodal 3D Geometric Perception with Hierarchical Attention for Robust Drug-Target Interaction and Binding Affinity Prediction.
items.title_zh: DTBNet：具有分层注意力的多模态3D几何感知，用于稳健的药物-靶标相互作用和结合亲和力预测。
items.summary_zh: 准确预测药物-靶标相互作用（DTI）和结合亲和力（DTA）是加速药物发现的核心挑战。虽然现有计算方法已取得进展，但大多数模型因依赖1D序列或2D图结构而难以捕捉3D空间中的关键物理化学相互作用，并且在冷启动场景中泛化能力有限。本研究提出DTBNet，一个整合多模态几何感知和分层注意力的统一预测框架。该框架通过结合蛋白质3D几何特征和多层次药物表示，构建了结合局部化学细节与全局生物信息的异质嵌入。在跨模态交互中，原子-残基交叉注意力首先捕捉配对特异性局部关联，随后组级多头自注意力整合互补的化学语义、全局结构和局部几何交互表示。在基准数据集（Davis、KIBA、PDBBind）上的实验表明，与最优基线模型相比，DTBNet的均方误差最多降低19.8%，Pearson相关系数提高8.0%，在药物冷启动、靶标冷启动和完全新颖配对场景中保持最优性能，展现出稳健的跨域适应性。在GPCR靶标上的独立验

extra.description: Accurate prediction of drug-target interactions (DTIs) and binding affinity (DTA) constitutes a core challenge in accelerating drug discovery. While existing computational methods have made progress, most models struggle to capture critical physicochemical interactions in 3D space due to reliance on 1D sequences or 2D graph structures, and exhibit limited generalization in cold-start scenarios. This study proposes DTBNet, a unified prediction framework integrating multimodal geometric perception and hierarchical attention. The framework constructs heterogeneous embeddings combining local chemical details with global biological information by incorporating protein 3D geometric features and multilevel drug representations. During cross-modal interaction, atom-residue cross-attention first captures pair-specific local associations, followed by group-level multi-head self-attention that integrates complementary chemical-semantic, global structural, and local geometric interaction representations. Experiments on benchmark datasets (Davis, KIBA, PDBBind) demonstrate that compared with the optimal baseline models, DTBNet achieves up to 19.8% reduction in mean squared error and 8.0% improvement in Pearson correlation coefficient, maintaining optimal performance in drug cold-start, target cold-start, and completely novel pairing scenarios, showcasing robust cross-domain adaptability. Independent validation on GPCR targets achieves RMSE 0.783, confirming real-world applicability. Visualization analyses reveal DTBNet precisely identifies interaction sites between key transmembrane helical domain residues and drug aromatic rings, with attention distribution highly consistent with experimentally resolved binding conformations. These results establish DTBNet as a new performance benchmark through 3D geometric perception and dynamic attention mechanisms, providing interpretable molecular insights for structure-based rational drug design and demonstrating broad potential in virtual screening and target discovery. The source code and data are available at https://github.com/wyx2012/DTB_Net. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: spOT-NMF: gene expression deconvolution via optimal transport with proximity-aware niche mapping for spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: spOT-NMF：通过最优传输与邻近感知生态位映射进行基因表达反卷积用于空间转录组学
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间转录组学能够直接分析完整组织内的细胞组织，然而两个挑战限制了其充分利用：混合表达信号（包括异种移植等物种混合模型）的准确无参考反卷积，以及缺乏能将每个斑点的程序使用值转化为空间生态位的工具。我们开发了spOT-NMF，一种基于最优传输的非负矩阵分解方法，用Wasserstein距离替代标准重建损失，无需匹配的单细胞图谱即可解开混合信号。虽然广义OT-NMF分解适用于任何表达矩阵，但基于邻近性的生态位推断模块进一步将空间转录组中的程序共使用转化为定义组织区室及其边界的方向共现网络。在涵盖亚细胞到多细胞分辨率、多个平台和两种物种混合场景的五个金标准数据集上进行基准测试，spOT-NMF在无参考方法中排名第一，在异种移植特有的信号不平衡条件下尤其具有优势。我们表明无参考反卷积能够恢复匹配单细胞图谱中缺失的细胞群体，突显了无监督分析的价值。应用于胶质母细胞瘤异种移植和人类结直肠癌，spO

extra.description: Abstract Spatial transcriptomics enables direct profiling of cellular organization within intact tissues, yet two challenges limit its full exploitation: accurate reference-free deconvolution of mixed expression signals (including species-admixed models such as xenografts), and lack of tools that can translate per-spot program usage values into spatial niches. We developed spOT-NMF, an optimal transport-based non-negative matrix factorization method that replaces standard reconstruction loss with the Wasserstein distance to disentangle mixed signals without requiring matched single-cell atlases. While the generalized OT-NMF factorization is applicable to any expression matrix, a proximity-based niche inference module further translates program co-usage from spatial transcriptomes into directional co-occurrence networks that define tissue compartments and their boundaries. Benchmarking across five gold-standard datasets spanning sub-cellular to multi-cellular resolutions, multiple platforms, and two-species admixture scenarios, spOT-NMF ranks first among reference-free methods, with particular advantage under the signal imbalance conditions characteristic of xenografts. We show that reference-free deconvolution recovers cell populations absent from matched single-cell atlases, highlighting the value of unsupervised analysis. Applied to glioblastoma xenografts and human colorectal cancer, spOT-NMF reveals spatially restricted interferon signaling, invasion routes, and CAF–tumor boundaries. spOT-NMF is available as an open-source Python package with GPU, CPU, and HPC support.

items.title: Identifying multi-omics spatial domains via masked autoencoder and diffusion-based latent regularization with SpaMEDM
items.title_zh: 通过掩码自编码器和基于扩散的潜在正则化与SpaMEDM识别多组学空间域
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间多组学数据提供了组织组织的互补分子视图。然而，由于数据稀疏性、技术噪声和模态特异性分布，其整合仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了空间掩码自编码器和基于扩散的模型（SpaMEDM），一个端到端图表示学习框架，它增强了双注意力图整合骨干，并加入了掩码重建和基于扩散的潜在噪声预测正则化。在掩码轨道中，通过利用模态和图特定的邻域信息来恢复随机掩码的斑点特征。同时，在随机采样的噪声水平下对模态特定的潜在表示施加高斯扰动，并训练一个空间图信息网络来预测注入的噪声。这种基于扩散的目标仅在训练期间使用，以鼓励对潜在扰动的鲁棒性，而不是在推理期间执行迭代反向扩散或采样。此外，基于余弦的配对斑点方向对齐和邻接重建鼓励兼容的跨模态表示并保留所选图结构。SpaMEDM灵活支持纯空间、双特征-空间和模态特定特征修剪的空间图配置。在不同空间多组学数据集上的评估展示了有竞争力的空间域识别性能，并产生促进下游探

extra.description: Abstract Spatial multi-omics data provide complementary molecular views of tissue organization. However, their integration remains challenging due to data sparsity, technical noise, and modality-specific distributions. Here, we present Spatial Masked autoEncoder and Diffusion-based Model (SpaMEDM), an end-to-end graph representation learning framework that augments a dual-attention graph-integration backbone with masked reconstruction and diffusion-based latent noise-prediction regularization. In the masked track, randomly masked spot features are recovered by leveraging modality- and graph-specific neighborhood information. In parallel, Gaussian perturbations are applied to modality-specific latent representations at randomly sampled noise levels, and a spatial-graph-informed network is trained to predict the injected noise. This diffusion-based objective is used exclusively during training to encourage robustness to latent perturbations, rather than to perform iterative reverse diffusion or sampling during inference. Furthermore, cosine-based paired-spot directional alignment and adjacency reconstruction encourage compatible cross-modality representations and preservation of the selected graph structure. SpaMEDM flexibly supports purely spatial, dual feature–spatial, and modality-specific feature-pruned spatial graph configurations. Evaluations across diverse spatial multi-omics datasets demonstrate competitive spatial-domain identification performance and produce integrated embeddings that facilitate downstream exploratory analyses.

items.title: Structured multi-view relational learning for drug response prediction
items.title_zh: 用于药物反应预测的结构化多视图关系学习
items.summary_zh: 摘要 药物反应预测（DRP）需要能够联合表征分子药物结构和异质细胞状态的模型。尽管近期深度学习方法已将多组学图谱与药物表征整合，但许多方法将组学视图视为并行特征来源或在关系建模前将其合并，这可能削弱组学视图特异的细胞系关系结构。在此，我们提出MulDR，一个结构化多视图关系学习框架，在药物条件化的细胞–药物交互之前保留组学视图特异的细胞系关系结构。MulDR为通路活性、基因表达、突变和DNA甲基化构建独立的关系结构，学习视图特异的关系细胞表征，并使用互补的基序级、几何感知分子图和Morgan指纹药物表征来条件化其融合。通过这种设计，细胞系相似性在交互阶段之前保持视图依赖，而非被过早压缩为单一特征或关系空间。大量实验表明，MulDR在相同评估协议下持续优于代表性和近期基线，相对于最强基线将均方根误差降低6.07%。对未见药物和细胞系的冷启动评估进一步表明MulDR能泛化到先前未见的实体，而消

extra.description: Abstract Drug response prediction (DRP) requires models that jointly characterize molecular drug structure and heterogeneous cellular states. Although recent deep learning approaches have integrated multi-omics profiles with drug representations, many treat omics views as parallel feature sources or merge them before relational modeling, which can weaken omics-view-specific cell-line relation structures. Here, we propose MulDR, a structured multi-view relational learning framework that preserves omics-view-specific cell-line relation structures before drug-conditioned cell–drug interaction. MulDR constructs separate relation structures for pathway activity, gene expression, mutation, and DNA methylation, learns view-specific relational cell representations, and uses complementary motif-level, geometry-aware molecular graph, and Morgan fingerprint drug representations to condition their fusion. With this design, cell-line similarity remains view-dependent until the interaction stage, rather than being prematurely compressed into a single feature or relation space. Extensive experiments show that MulDR consistently outperforms representative and recent baselines under the same evaluation protocol, reducing root mean square error by 6.07% relative to the strongest baseline. Cold-start evaluations on unseen drugs and cell lines further show that MulDR generalizes to previously unseen entities, while ablation studies show that removing either view-specific relational modeling or drug-conditioned fusion consistently compromises predictive performance. Together, these results suggest that preserving omics-specific cell-line relations before drug-conditioned interaction modeling provides an effective strategy for robust DRP.

items.title: Multi-omics survival prediction under modality incompleteness via dynamic modality graphs and product-of-experts fusion
items.title_zh: 通过动态模态图和专家乘积融合在模态不完整下的多组学生存预测
items.summary_zh: 摘要 多组学数据整合为癌症生存预测提供了丰富的互补信息，然而模态不完整在真实医疗数据中普遍存在，削弱了现有模型的稳定性和适用性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出DMG-PoE，一个用于多组学生存预测的稳健学习框架。该框架引入动态模态图（DMG），在模态节点之间传播互补信息以补偿缺失输入，并结合不确定性感知的专家乘积（PoE）融合机制，按每个模态的估计精度自适应加权，以及一致性约束训练策略，在不同模态子集上稳定预测。在SurvBoard基准上对10种TCGA癌症类型和七种组学模态的系统评估表明，DMG-PoE在标准设置（完整模态训练/测试）和缺失增强设置（训练额外包含真实不完整样本和非临床模态丢弃，仅完整测试）下均取得最高平均C-index；受控的逐模态掩蔽实验在22/24个癌症-模态组合中验证了有效的测试时恢复，而仅七种模态中两种可用时的跨队列迁移进一步证实了严重输入限制下的泛化能力。

extra.description: Abstract Multi-omics data integration provides rich complementary information for cancer survival prediction, yet modality incompleteness is pervasive in real-world medical data and undermines the stability and applicability of existing models. To address this challenge, we propose DMG-PoE, a robust learning framework for multi-omics survival prediction. The framework introduces a dynamic modality graph (DMG) that propagates complementary information across modality nodes to compensate for missing inputs, combined with an uncertainty-aware product-of-experts (PoE) fusion mechanism that adaptively weights each modality by its estimated precision, and a consistency-constrained training strategy that stabilizes predictions across varying modality subsets. Systematic evaluation on the SurvBoard benchmark across 10 TCGA cancer types and seven omics modalities demonstrates that DMG-PoE achieves the highest average C-index under both the standard setting (complete-modality training/testing) and the missing-augmented setting (training additionally includes real incomplete samples and nonclinical modality dropout, with complete-only testing); controlled per-modality masking experiments validate effective test-time recovery in 22/24 cancer-modality combinations, and cross-cohort transfer with only two of seven modalities available further confirms generalization under severe input restriction.

items.title: Impact of training data on deep learning–based RNA 3D structure quality assessment
items.title_zh: 训练数据对基于深度学习的RNA 3D结构质量评估的影响
items.summary_zh: 摘要 对预测RNA 3D结构进行准确的免参考评估对于大规模RNA建模至关重要，但训练数据对基于深度学习的质量预测器的影响仍知之甚少。在此，我们对三个用于RNA 3D结构质量评估的深度学习预测器进行了系统的交叉训练分析，每个预测器最初都在不同的训练集上开发。通过在替代（非原生）数据集上重新训练每个预测器——包括专门为本项目创建的新数据集RNA3DQA——并在独立的RNA-Puzzles基准上评估性能，我们系统地评估了模型架构和训练数据组成的相对贡献。我们的结果揭示了跨数据集泛化方面的显著差异，预测器在非原生数据集上训练时往往比在其原生数据集上表现更好。值得注意的是，训练数据集的影响因预测器而异，RNA3DQA特别为ARES模型带来了整体最佳的准确性和排名稳定性结果。原生训练集为RNA3DCNN和lociPARSE带来了更好的性能。这些发现表明，训练数据的特征在塑造免参考RNA 3D结构质量评

extra.description: Abstract Accurate reference-free assessment of predicted RNA 3D structures is essential for large-scale RNA modeling, yet the impact of training data on deep learning–based quality predictors remains poorly understood. Here, we present a systematic cross-training analysis of three deep learning predictors for RNA 3D structure quality assessment, each originally developed on distinct training sets. By retraining each predictor on alternative (nonnative) datasets—including RNA3DQA, a new set created specifically for this project—and evaluating performance on independent RNA-Puzzles benchmarks, we systematically assess the relative contributions of model architecture and training data composition. Our results reveal pronounced differences in cross-dataset generalization, with predictors often performing better when trained on nonnative datasets than on their native ones. Notably, the impact of the training datasets varied across predictors, with RNA3DQA yielding the overall best accuracy and ranking stability results specifically for the ARES model. Native training sets yielded better performance for RNA3DCNN and lociPARSE. These findings demonstrate that the characteristics of the training data play a dominant, model-dependent role in shaping the performance and robustness of reference-free RNA 3D structure quality assessment methods. We conclude with practical recommendations for designing transferable training datasets and for benchmarking deep learning–based quality predictors in RNA structural bioinformatics.

items.title: BIOREDIS: an integrated platform for end-to-end design of nucleic acid therapeutics.
items.title_zh: BIOREDIS：一个用于核酸治疗药物端到端设计的集成平台。
items.summary_zh: 开发最先进的RNA和DNA治疗药物需要先进的计算框架来支持整个工作流程——从生物学原理到最终药物构建体——实现高精度的组织和细胞特异性靶向。现有生物信息学工具仅提供部分解决方案，很少直接生成适合合成或临床前评估的设计。为解决这些局限，我们提出BIOREDIS，一个基于网络的综合性核酸治疗设计平台。BIOREDIS整合了来自九个主要生物资源的精选数据，并包含编码序列优化、RNA干扰（shRNA/siRNA）设计、启动子/UTR选择以及病毒（AAV、慢病毒）、非病毒和mRNA疫苗载体的自动化构建模块。该平台支持人类、小鼠和大鼠的设计，为人类和小鼠提供组织特异性启动子推荐，高级细胞表达谱分析原生仅限于人类。BIOREDIS在编码序列优化和RNAi预测方面表现出竞争力，同时独特地提供从靶标选择到完全指定、可直接合成和实验验证的下一代DNA或RNA治疗构建体的端到端工作流程。BIOREDIS可在ht

extra.description: Developing state-of-the-art RNA- and DNA-based therapeutics requires advanced computational frameworks that support the entire workflow - from biological rationale to the final drug construct - enabling tissue- and cell-specific targeting with high precision. Existing bioinformatics tools provide only partial solutions and rarely generate designs directly suitable for synthesis or preclinical evaluation. To address these limitations, we present BIOREDIS, a web-based platform for comprehensive nucleic acid therapeutic design. BIOREDIS integrates curated data from nine major biological resources and incorporates modules for coding sequence optimization, RNA interference (shRNA/siRNA) design, promoter/UTR selection, and automated construction of viral (AAV, lentiviral), non-viral, and mRNA vaccine vectors. The platform supports designs for human, mouse, and rat, with tissue-specific promoter recommendations available for human and mouse, and advanced cell-expression profiling natively restricted to human. BIOREDIS demonstrates competitive performance in coding sequence optimization and RNAi prediction, while uniquely providing an end-to-end workflow from target selection to fully specified next-generation DNA or RNA therapeutic constructs ready for synthesis and experimental validation. BIOREDIS is freely available at https://rnadrug.ichb.pl/bioredis, with a mirror site at https://bioredis.cs.put.poznan.pl. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: CellSavior: an open-source framework for improved cell calling in targeted single-cell DNA sequencing.
items.title_zh: CellSavior：一个用于改进靶向单细胞DNA测序中细胞判定的开源框架。
items.summary_zh: 单细胞DNA测序（scDNA-seq）已成为研究复杂基因组变异（包括肿瘤异质性）的关键方法。尽管其商业可用性日益增加（以Tapestri平台为例），但由于依赖专有且不透明的流程，分析可重复性仍然有限。在预处理步骤中，细胞判定尤为关键，因为它决定哪些条形码对应真实细胞而非背景噪声，并直接影响所有下游分析。然而，现有方法通常依赖经验阈值，且在不同数据集上表现不一致。这些局限凸显了对稳健且可泛化的细胞判定框架的需求，以实现可靠的scDNA-seq分析。我们开发了CellSavior，一个开源细胞判定算法，带有集成的下游流程，可产生标准化输出。CellSavior采用跨多个距离指标的集成聚类策略，结合置信度加权合并，生成共识分类，以减少偏差并提高稳健性。在33个公开和内部单细胞DNA测序数据集上，CellSavior在31个案例（93.9%）中重现了商业软件（CellFinder）生成的细胞注释。

extra.description: Single-cell DNA sequencing (scDNA-seq) has emerged as a key approach for studying complex genomic variation, including tumor heterogeneity. Despite its increasing commercial availability, exemplified by the Tapestri platform, analytical reproducibility remains limited due to reliance on proprietary and non-transparent pipelines. Among preprocessing steps, cell calling is particularly critical, as it determines which barcodes correspond to true cells rather than background noise and directly shapes all downstream analyses. However, existing methods typically rely on empirical thresholding and exhibit inconsistent performance across datasets. These limitations underscore the need for a robust and generalizable cell calling framework for reliable scDNA-seq analysis. We developed CellSavior, an open-source cell calling algorithm with an integrated downstream pipeline that produces standardized outputs. CellSavior employs an ensemble clustering strategy across multiple distance metrics, combined with confidence-weighted merging, to generate a consensus classification that reduces bias and improves robustness. Across 33 public and in-house single-cell DNA sequencing datasets, CellSavior recapitulated cell annotations generated by commercial software (CellFinder) in 31 cases (93.9%). In the remaining discordant cases, CellSavior yielded more biologically interpretable annotations, rescuing previously undetected clusters enriched for key hotspot genomic alterations. The source code for CellSavior is freely available at https://github.com/dauer-tgilab/CellSavior; DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22744146. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: iCellOmics: connecting multi-omics profiles and phenotype evidence across industrially relevant cell lines.
items.title_zh: iCellOmics：连接工业相关细胞系的多组学谱和表型证据。
items.summary_zh: 工业相关细胞系包括生物制品、疫苗和病毒载体的直接生产宿主，以及作为宿主细胞工程和比较研究参考的生物医学模型。然而，它们的基因组、转录组和表观基因组谱，以及文献衍生的表型信息，仍分散在不同存储库、项目产出和出版物中。在此，我们提出iCellOmics（https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/icellomics），一个开放获取数据库，在统一的数据和分析框架内整合工业相关细胞系的多组学数据。当前版本涵盖17个细胞系，提供7个物种的参考基因组，包括144,018个蛋白编码基因、170,408,888个基因组变异、673个差异表达比较、30个不同的单细胞RNA-seq BioProject（包含1,047,274个细胞）、287,089,415个ATAC-seq峰、37,213个去重文献 curated 基因-表型关系，跨越104个标准化表型亚类。该数据库支持以细胞系为中心浏览可用数据集和

extra.description: Industrially relevant cell lines include direct production hosts for biologics, vaccines, and viral vectors, as well as biomedical models that serve as references for host-cell engineering and comparative studies. However, their genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic profiles, together with literature-derived phenotype information, remain distributed across different repositories, project outputs, and publications. Here, we present iCellOmics (https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/icellomics), an open-access database that integrates multi-omics data for industrially relevant cell lines within a unified data and analysis framework. The current release covers 17 cell lines and provides reference genomes for seven species, encompassing 144 018 protein-coding genes, 170 408 888 genomic variants, 673 differential-expression comparisons, 30 distinct single-cell RNA-seq BioProjects comprising 1 047 274 cells, 287 089 415 ATAC-seq peaks, 37 213 deduplicated literature-curated gene-phenotype relationships spanning 104 standardized phenotype subcategories. The database supports both cell line-centric browsing of available datasets and gene-centric exploration of cross-omics analysis results. Additionally, iCellOmics offers online GO and KEGG enrichment analysis tools to facilitate further data exploration. In summary, iCellOmics provides a valuable starting point for investigating gene-phenotype relationships in industrially relevant cell lines and supports cell-line engineering and the development of improved producer lines.

items.title: PlantPAN 5.0: updated database for integrating multiomics evidence and exploring multilayered transcriptional regulatory networks in plants.
items.title_zh: PlantPAN 5.0：整合多组学证据和探索植物多层转录调控网络的更新数据库。
items.summary_zh: 植物启动子分析导航器（PlantPAN）5.0（https://plantpan.itps.ncku.edu.tw/）是一个用于研究植物顺式调控元件和转录调控网络的综合多组学资源。本版本将基因组注释和启动子序列扩展到240个物种，提供71,040个转录因子（TF）注释和7,762个非冗余结合矩阵。其配套数据库PCBase 3.0大幅扩展了ChIP-seq数据，并新纳入拟南芥的ATAC-seq、亚硫酸氢盐测序和四个基于Hi-C的染色质相互作用数据集。新的差异分析功能能够比较不同条件下的TF结合、染色质可及性和DNA甲基化。重新设计的启动子分析界面提供TF家族级统计，模式概览面板整合了TF结合位点（TFBS）密度、植物DNA大语言模型预测的开放染色质区域、CpG富集区域和串联重复。引入两个新模块：（i）转录组调控分析与共表达，通过差异表达和共表达分析优先考虑基因集中的候选调控TF和共享顺式元件

extra.description: Plant Promoter Analysis Navigator (PlantPAN) 5.0 (https://plantpan.itps.ncku.edu.tw/) is an integrated multiomics resource for investigating plant cis-regulatory elements and transcriptional regulatory networks. This release expands genome annotations and promoter sequences to 240 species and provides 71 040 transcription factor (TF) annotations and 7762 nonredundant binding matrices. Its companion database, PCBase 3.0, substantially expands ChIP-seq data and newly incorporates ATAC-seq, bisulfite-sequencing, and four Hi-C-based chromatin interaction datasets for Arabidopsis thaliana. The new Differential Analysis function enables comparison of TF binding, chromatin accessibility, and DNA methylation across conditions. The redesigned Promoter Analysis interface provides TF family-level statistics, with a Pattern Overview panel integrating TF-binding site (TFBS) densities, plant DNA large language model-predicted open-chromatin regions, CpG-rich regions, and tandem repeats. Two new modules are introduced: (i) Transcriptome Regulatory Analysis and Coexpression, where candidate regulatory TFs and shared cis-elements in gene sets are prioritized through differential expression and coexpression analysis, and (ii) Interaction Topology Analysis for Chromatin and TFs, where chromatin interaction regions are integrated to reveal potentially coregulated genes and their shared TFs and predicted TFBSs. A Dockerized package enables large-scale local promoter analyses, with data privacy. Therefore, PlantPAN 5.0 is a comprehensive framework for discovering plant transcriptional regulatory mechanisms.

items.title: Gene Expression Nebulas 2.0: an updated resource of gene expression profiles by incorporating more datasets, annotations, and functionalities.
items.title_zh: Gene Expression Nebulas 2.0：通过纳入更多数据集、注释和功能更新的基因表达谱资源。
items.summary_zh: Gene Expression Nebulas（GEN；https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/gen/）是一个开放获取数据库，提供跨物种的标准化转录组谱和人工 curated 元数据。与上一版本相比，更新后的GEN在数据集方面从323个扩展到668个，样本从50,500个扩展到102,679个，细胞从15,540,169个扩展到23,461,252个，物种从30个扩展到100个。GEN 2.0增加了空间转录组数据和来自82个人类bulk RNA-seq数据集的疾病相关表达注释，涵盖12个疾病系统的62个疾病类别（包括不同亚型）。此外，它通过为人工智能应用提供高质量基因表达谱、提供基于网络的服务以接受转录组数据提交，以及更新用于跨物种、组织和疾病基因表达比较的在线分析工具，实现了显著升级。总之，GEN提供跨物种更全面、标准化的基因表达谱，从而成为揭示分子功能机制和破译复杂调控架构的

extra.description: Gene Expression Nebulas (GEN; https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/gen/) is an open-access database that provides standardized transcriptomic profiles and manually curated metadata across diverse species. Compared with the previous release, the updated GEN has expanded in terms of datasets from 323 to 668, samples from 50 500 to 102 679, cells from 15 540 169 to 23 461 252, and species from 30 to 100. GEN 2.0 adds spatial transcriptomics data and disease-associated expression annotations from 82 human bulk RNA-seq datasets spanning 62 disease categories, including distinct subtypes, across 12 disease systems. In addition, it has been significantly upgraded by providing high-quality gene expression profiles for artificial intelligence applications, a web-based service to accept transcriptomic data submission, and an updated online analysis tool for gene expression comparisons across species, tissues, and diseases. Together, GEN offers more comprehensive, standardized gene expression profiles across diverse species and thus serves as a fundamental resource for uncovering molecular functional mechanisms and deciphering complex regulatory architecture.

items.title: scGWAS-DB: an integrated database bridging GWAS to tissue-resolved single-cell contexts.
items.title_zh: scGWAS-DB：一个连接GWAS与组织分辨单细胞背景的集成数据库。
items.summary_zh: 全基因组关联研究（GWAS）与单细胞RNA测序的整合使得在组织分辨的细胞背景中剖析复杂性状架构成为可能。然而，现有资源缺乏识别性状-细胞类型关联背后枢纽基因、剖析基因-基因相互作用拓扑或检测跨多个性状共享基因的能力。在此，我们提出单细胞辅助全基因组关联研究数据库（scGWAS-DB）（https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/scgwasdb），一个连接群体规模遗传学与单细胞生物学的集成数据库。scGWAS-DB整合了3,649个高质量GWAS数据集与涵盖74种人类组织和1,713种细胞类型的单细胞图谱。从这些数据中，我们识别了213,992个显著三元组，包含821,480个基因-基因相互作用。其中，我们进一步区分了584,944个共现和7,365个互斥基因-基因相互作用模式。系统整合这些网络揭示了跨多种疾病的反复出现的细胞特征。总之，scGWAS-DB为解释复杂性状的细胞基础提供了

extra.description: The integration of genome-wide association studies (GWAS) with single-cell RNA sequencing has enabled the dissection of complex trait architectures across tissue-resolved cellular contexts. However, existing resources lack the ability to identify hub genes underlying trait-cell-type associations, dissect gene-gene interaction topologies, or detect shared genes across multiple traits. Here, we present single-cell-assisted Genome-Wide Association Study DataBase (scGWAS-DB) (https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/scgwasdb), an integrated database that bridges population-scale genetics with single-cell biology. scGWAS-DB integrates 3,649 high-quality GWAS datasets with single-cell atlases spanning 74 human tissues and 1,713 cell types. From these data, we identified 213,992 significant triplets, encompassing 821,480 gene-gene interactions. Among them, we further distinguished 584,944 co-occurrent and 7,365 mutual exclusive gene-gene interaction patterns. Systematic integration of these networks revealed recurrent cellular signatures across diverse diseases. Collectively, scGWAS-DB provides a systematic resource for interpreting the cellular basis of complex traits, prioritizing hub genes and cell types that could provide insights in future studies of drug target development and disease-relevant cellular circuit discovery.

items.title: gcPathogen 2.0: an expanded multi-omics database advancing global pathogen surveillance and One Health research.
items.title_zh: gcPathogen 2.0：一个扩展的多组学数据库，推进全球病原体监测和One Health研究。
items.summary_zh: gcPathogen于2024年启动，为人类病原体的基因组监测奠定了关键基础。在此，我们提出gcPathogen 2.0，一次重大多组学更新，旨在解决关键分析瓶颈，包括基因组和转录谱的整合、跨栖息地分布的系统追踪以及抗菌肽（AMP）的大规模发现。本版本将覆盖范围从1,134种扩展到1,506种病原体物种，涵盖557种细菌、508种真菌、258种病毒和183种寄生虫，并将总基因组记录增加到超过230万条。通过纳入148个物种的12,597个转录组，gcPathogen 2.0弥合了基因携带与功能表达之间的差距，用于风险评估。此外，该平台整合了285,925个病原体宏基因组组装基因组（MAG），跨越人类、动物和环境生态位。这些MAG映射到68个环境本体（ENVO）栖息地类别，能够全面追踪病原体、抗生素抗性基因（ARG）、毒力因子（VF）和移动遗传元件（MGE）的跨栖息地分布。利用从七个公共数据

extra.description: Launched in 2024, gcPathogen established a critical foundation for the genomic surveillance of human pathogens. Here, we present gcPathogen 2.0, a major multi-omics update designed to address key analytical bottlenecks, including the integration of genomic and transcriptional profiles, systematic tracking of cross-habitat distribution, and large-scale discovery of antimicrobial peptides (AMPs). This release expands coverage from 1134 to 1506 pathogenic species, spanning 557 bacteria, 508 fungi, 258 viruses, and 183 parasites, and increases total genomic records past 2.3 million. By incorporating 12 597 transcriptomes across 148 species, gcPathogen 2.0 bridges the gap between gene carriage and functional expression for risk assessment. Furthermore, the platform integrates 285 925 pathogen metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) spanning human, animal, and environmental niches. Mapped across 68 Environment Ontology (ENVO) habitat categories, these MAGs enable comprehensive tracking of cross-habitat distribution of pathogens, antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs), virulence factors (VFs), and mobile genetic elements (MGEs). Leveraging a nonredundant reference set curated from seven public databases, we identified over 77 million AMPs belonging to >55 000 families across 438 bacterial pathogens. Finally, pan-genome analyses of 440 bacterial species map intraspecies functional distributions across core, accessory, and unique gene repertoires. gcPathogen 2.0 is publicly accessible at https://nmdc.cn/gcpathogen/.

items.title: The Immune Epitope Database (IEDB) in 2026: updates of immune receptor data.
items.title_zh: 免疫表位数据库（IEDB）2026：免疫受体数据更新。
items.summary_zh: 免疫表位数据库（IEDB，iedb.org）是一个免费资源，收录实验定义的免疫表位以及（在报告的情况下）识别它们的免疫受体。IEDB目前记录约235,000个不同的T细胞受体和约6,400个不同的B细胞受体/抗体，具有实验验证的表位特异性。在此，我们描述IEDB的最新更新，重点是对这些受体数据的全面修订。由于受体是从跨越数十年的3,879篇参考文献中 curated 的，基因命名和CDR界定的异质性给计算分析和用户查询带来挑战。我们重建了标准化和验证流程，以计算符合IUIS/IMGT的V/D/J基因名称，并一致地界定V结构域、CDR1、2、3和连接序列，并从822篇参考文献中识别异常受体进行重新 curated。IEDB网络界面已扩展，包括主页上的受体搜索功能、在精炼受体搜索中支持V/J基因和物种选项，以及以适应性免疫受体库（AIRR）格式直接导出数据。我们预计改进的数据质量将简化生物信息

extra.description: The Immune Epitope Database (IEDB, iedb.org) is a freely available resource cataloging experimentally defined immune epitopes and, where reported, the immune receptors that recognize them. The IEDB currently records ∼235 000 distinct T cell receptors and ∼6400 distinct B cell receptors/antibodies with experimentally verified epitope specificity. Here, we describe recent updates to the IEDB, centered on a comprehensive revision of these receptor data. Because receptors were curated from 3879 references spanning decades, heterogeneity in gene nomenclature and CDR delimitation presents challenges for computational analyses and user queries. We rebuilt the standardization and validation pipeline to compute IUIS/IMGT-compliant V/D/J gene names and consistently delimited V domain, CDR1, 2, 3, and Junction sequences, and identify anomalous receptors from 822 references for re-curation. The IEDB web interface was expanded to include receptor search features directly on the homepage, support V/J gene and species options in the refined receptor search, and direct data export in the Adaptive Immune Receptor Repertoire (AIRR) format. We anticipate that the improved data quality will simplify bioinformatics analyses and facilitate integration into cross-repository data resources, such as the AIRR Knowledge Commons.

items.title: Deciphering the gene-centric spatial dynamics across tissue and time with GeneSPOT.
items.title_zh: 用GeneSPOT破译跨组织和时间的以基因为中心的空间动态。
items.summary_zh: 空间组学技术为研究分子程序如何在组织内组织提供了前所未有的机会。然而，现有分析框架主要关注识别细胞状态和表征这些状态间的差异表达分子特征。因此，分子特征的关系空间组织及其在生物背景中的动态在很大程度上仍未被探索。在此，我们提出Gene SPatial Optimal Transport（GeneSPOT），一个以基因为中心的计算框架，用于表征基因间的空间关系并量化它们在不同生物条件下的重组。尽管设计上以基因为中心，GeneSPOT可推广到其他分子特征。在多种应用中，GeneSPOT解析了组织结构，整合了配对和非配对空间多组学数据，揭示了胚胎发育过程中基因程序的空间汇聚，并识别了与衰老相关的空间重组——这些基因的表达并未随年龄显著变化。因此，GeneSPOT补充了传统的以细胞为中心的分析，提供了一个框架来破译分子特征间的空间关系如何在不同生物条件和时间中重组。

extra.description: Spatial omics technologies provide unprecedented opportunities to investigate how molecular programs are organized within tissues. However, existing analytical frameworks primarily focus on identifying cellular states and characterizing differentially expressed molecular features across these states. The relational spatial organization of molecular features and its dynamics across biological contexts therefore remain largely unexplored. Here we present Gene SPatial Optimal Transport (GeneSPOT), a gene-centric computational framework for characterizing the spatial relationships among genes and quantifying their reorganization across biological conditions. Although gene-centric in design, GeneSPOT generalizes to other molecular features. Across diverse applications, GeneSPOT resolved tissue structures, integrated paired and unpaired spatial multi-omics data, unveiled the spatial convergence of gene programs during embryonic development and identified aging-associated spatial reorganization among genes whose expression did not change significantly with age. GeneSPOT thus complements conventional cell-centric analysis, providing a framework for deciphering how spatial relationships among molecular features are reorganized across biological conditions and over time.

items.title: 基于威胁感知的Tor多路径选择
items.title_zh: 基于威胁感知的Tor多路径选择
items.summary_zh: 随着机器学习和深度学习的发展应用,攻击者可以通过Tor用户链路上的恶意节点以及恶意AS对其进行流量分析,从而对Tor用户进行去匿名化攻击。目前,常见的针对流量分析攻击的防御方法有两类:一类是通过插入虚拟数据包,或者延迟真实数据包从而改变流量特征,这种方法会引入带宽和时延开销;另一类将用户流量分割并通过多个路径传输从而进行防御,这种方法缺少对电路上存在的恶意节点以及恶意AS的感知,当攻击者搜集到完整流量踪迹时,依旧难以抵御流量分析对Tor用户的去匿名化攻击。为了弥补多路径防御方法在路径选择上存在的缺乏威胁感知的问题,提出了融合恶意节点感知以及恶意AS感知的基于威胁感知的多路径选择算法。首先提出一种改进的节点距离度量的方法,然后使用改进后的距离度量,基于K-Mediods算法对节点进行聚类,提高了恶意节点的检测效果;之后改进了AS感知算法,提高了匿名性要求;最后融合恶意节点检测以及AS感知算法

extra.description: 随着机器学习和深度学习的发展应用,攻击者可以通过Tor用户链路上的恶意节点以及恶意AS对其进行流量分析,从而对Tor用户进行去匿名化攻击。目前,常见的针对流量分析攻击的防御方法有两类:一类是通过插入虚拟数据包,或者延迟真实数据包从而改变流量特征,这种方法会引入带宽和时延开销;另一类将用户流量分割并通过多个路径传输从而进行防御,这种方法缺少对电路上存在的恶意节点以及恶意AS的感知,当攻击者搜集到完整流量踪迹时,依旧难以抵御流量分析对Tor用户的去匿名化攻击。为了弥补多路径防御方法在路径选择上存在的缺乏威胁感知的问题,提出了融合恶意节点感知以及恶意AS感知的基于威胁感知的多路径选择算法。首先提出一种改进的节点距离度量的方法,然后使用改进后的距离度量,基于K-Mediods算法对节点进行聚类,提高了恶意节点的检测效果;之后改进了AS感知算法,提高了匿名性要求;最后融合恶意节点检测以及AS感知算法提出了一种基于威胁感知的多路径选择算法。实验结果表明,该算法不仅能抵抗多种流量分析攻击,而且保证了一定的Tor电路性能。

items.title: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

items.title: 基于多视图多样性学习的联合谱嵌入聚类算法
items.title_zh: 基于多视图多样性学习的联合谱嵌入聚类算法

items.title: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
items.title_zh: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
items.summary_zh: 随着云计算与空天地海一体化通信网络的深度融合, 各种复杂应用场景的出现使得组合服务的种类和数量急剧增多, 结构也变得复杂。在云网融合环境下, 用户移动设备和边缘服务器等硬件能力有限, 能耗问题成为组合服务进行动态重构不可忽略的重要因素。此外, 传统方法并未考虑空天地海不同场景下用户对不同服务质量(QoS)属性需求的差异性, 使得组合服务的交付结果并不令人满意。为了解决上述问题, 提出一种基于多目标粒子群优化(PSO)的组合服务动态重构方法。该方法首先根据重构原子服务的三维空间地理位置和功能进行聚类, 有效解决在云网融合环境下服务规模庞大情况下的搜索空间爆炸问题; 然后通过能耗计算模型得到服务调用的综合能耗, 并将其作为动态重构的优化目标之一, 结合服务的多种QoS属性进行多目标寻优, 最终生成符合用户需求且能耗较低的重构方案。实验结果表明, 该方法在云网融合环境下节约能耗和应对较大候选服务

items.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。

items.title: TH-FCAD：面向FPGA集群的大规模神经网络自动化部署框架
items.title_zh: TH-FCAD：面向FPGA集群的大规模神经网络自动化部署框架

extra.description:
<p<针对单颗FPGA资源受限难以加速大规模神经网络，且FPGA集群面临架构设计复杂、任务划分低效及自动化工具链缺失等挑战，提出面向FPGA集群的端到端自动化部署框架TH-FCAD（automated deployment framework for large-scale neural networks on FPGA clusters）。首先，构建基于TH-Express的2级互连集群架构，融合全局互连与局部互连，实现高带宽、低延迟的跨节点通信；其次，提出延迟平衡优化与模型切分方法，将大规模模型均匀切分为多加速核并保持核间延时均衡；最后，设计集群感知映射算法，联合FPGA资源约束与通信拓扑自动生成最优映射，以最小化通信开销。构建了完整的工具链，实现了从PyTorch/TensorFlow模型到集群的端到端自动化编译部署。基于16节点FPGA集群的评估表明，部署ResNet-8，SqueezeNet，ResNet-50时，推理延迟分别为0.051 ms，1.24 ms，1.36 ms，峰值算力达5.95 TOPS；较现有多FPGA方案性能提升28.4%，且优于CPU与GPU平台。</p<


计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(11): 2788-2806.

items.title: 面向数据流架构的稀疏矩阵高效处理内核
items.title_zh: 面向数据流架构的稀疏矩阵高效处理内核
items.summary_zh: <p<近年来，稀疏矩阵-密集矩阵乘（SpMM）已成为科学计算、图处理和深度学习等多个领域的核心算子和制约系统性能的瓶颈。然而，现有通用GPU上的SpMM实现普遍存在能效比、资源利用率低的问题，而一些专用的加速器虽然在规则计算上展现出了优异的能效比，但缺乏对不规则的稀疏矩阵运算的高效支持。针对此问题，基于高通量数据流众核处理器（DFU），提出了一种面向数据流架构的稀疏矩阵高效处理内核DFU-SpMM。首先提出数据流指令复用的分层稀疏矩阵处理方法，对稀疏数据进行重组织以减少SpMM内核的数据流图重传次数，同时，对于不同稀疏块使用不同的策略对其进行处理。然后提出面向流图优化的自适应汇编代码生成方法，引入观察者-执行者的思想，以突破现有DFU在SpMM内核生成方面的能力限制，并从任务分配和寄存器重用2个角度对代码生成过程中的数据流图构造进行优化。代表性数据集上的实验结果

extra.description:
<p<近年来，稀疏矩阵-密集矩阵乘（SpMM）已成为科学计算、图处理和深度学习等多个领域的核心算子和制约系统性能的瓶颈。然而，现有通用GPU上的SpMM实现普遍存在能效比、资源利用率低的问题，而一些专用的加速器虽然在规则计算上展现出了优异的能效比，但缺乏对不规则的稀疏矩阵运算的高效支持。针对此问题，基于高通量数据流众核处理器（DFU），提出了一种面向数据流架构的稀疏矩阵高效处理内核DFU-SpMM。首先提出数据流指令复用的分层稀疏矩阵处理方法，对稀疏数据进行重组织以减少SpMM内核的数据流图重传次数，同时，对于不同稀疏块使用不同的策略对其进行处理。然后提出面向流图优化的自适应汇编代码生成方法，引入观察者-执行者的思想，以突破现有DFU在SpMM内核生成方面的能力限制，并从任务分配和寄存器重用2个角度对代码生成过程中的数据流图构造进行优化。代表性数据集上的实验结果表明：相较于RTX 4090 GPU环境下的现有前沿工作DTC-SpMM和HP-SpMM，DFU-SpMM分别提高了平均1.09倍与1.23倍的能效以及1.71倍与1.10倍的计算资源利用率；相较于DFU加速器上数据重组织前的SpMM内核，优化后的内核实现了1.41倍的性能提升以及1.51倍的能效比提升。</p<


计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(11): 2807-2821.

items.title: Arm机密计算架构研究进展与展望
items.title_zh: Arm机密计算架构研究进展与展望
items.summary_zh: <p<随着云计算、大数据和人工智能的快速发展，数据安全与隐私保护已成为亟待解决的核心问题。2021年Arm提出机密计算架构（confidential compute architecture，CCA），通过硬件级隔离机制为敏感计算任务提供可信执行环境，保障数据与代码在使用过程中的安全性。尽管在用户态机密执行、设备隔离与系统安全增强等基于CCA的研究中已有初步成果，但整体来看，该领域仍处于起步阶段，现有研究较为分散，缺乏对架构发展与技术体系的系统性梳理。同时，部分研究重复构建底层关键机制，却未能总结技术共性。另一些工作则更关注功能实现，而对潜在攻击面及未来风险的分析不足。针对上述问题，对CCA在机密计算中的关键技术机制与研究进展进行系统分析，并对近年来具有代表性的成果进行分类归纳，涵盖执行环境扩展、设备隔离、应用适配与安全增强等方面的设计思路与实现路径。在此基础上

extra.description:
<p<随着云计算、大数据和人工智能的快速发展，数据安全与隐私保护已成为亟待解决的核心问题。2021年Arm提出机密计算架构（confidential compute architecture，CCA），通过硬件级隔离机制为敏感计算任务提供可信执行环境，保障数据与代码在使用过程中的安全性。尽管在用户态机密执行、设备隔离与系统安全增强等基于CCA的研究中已有初步成果，但整体来看，该领域仍处于起步阶段，现有研究较为分散，缺乏对架构发展与技术体系的系统性梳理。同时，部分研究重复构建底层关键机制，却未能总结技术共性。另一些工作则更关注功能实现，而对潜在攻击面及未来风险的分析不足。针对上述问题，对CCA在机密计算中的关键技术机制与研究进展进行系统分析，并对近年来具有代表性的成果进行分类归纳，涵盖执行环境扩展、设备隔离、应用适配与安全增强等方面的设计思路与实现路径。在此基础上，结合典型系统案例，凝练CCA研究中常用的技术路径，包含根世界隔离、多颗粒表内存隔离机制、2阶段页表与系统内存管理单元协同等关键技术。最后，进一步探讨当前CCA面临的主要挑战与研究趋势，为Arm机密计算领域的研究与创新提供参考。</p<


计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(11): 2822-2842.

items.title: SCoT-SQL：一种基于思维链引导的Text-to-SQL数据合成方法
items.title_zh: SCoT-SQL：一种基于思维链引导的Text-to-SQL数据合成方法
items.summary_zh: <p<在Text-to-SQL任务中，模型通常需要大规模的标注数据进行训练，而标注这些数据往往耗费大量的时间和人力成本。因此，数据稀缺性成为制约该领域发展、尤其是在特定领域应用中的关键瓶颈。在此背景下，基于大语言模型（large language model，LLM）的数据增强虽已成为一种有效的解决方案，然而当前Text-to-SQL领域的大多数现有方法严重依赖于原始数据集的分布，且其合成的数据往往缺乏可靠性与可解释性。针对上述问题，提出了一种思维链引导的数据合成方法SCoT-SQL。通过整合自然语言指令与包括数据库模式及表内容在内的符号知识，有效指引大模型减少数据合成过程中的语义错误。为确保合成数据的高质量，SCoT-SQL结合了模型自一致性投票与执行验证机制来进行严格的数据过滤。此外，还引入了基于思维链推理的模型自反馈机制对合成数据进行校准，在修正SQL查询

计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(11): 2939-2951.

items.title: 基于共性-特性协同建模与多专家融合的多特征图像描述模型
items.title_zh: 基于共性-特性协同建模与多专家融合的多特征图像描述模型

计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(11): 3002-3016.

items.title: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.title_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

items.title: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.title_zh: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.summary_zh: 近年来,大语言模型(Large Language Models,LLMs)技术迎来了快速发展,其在各行业的应用呈现出蓬勃增长的态势。从自然语言处理到智能推荐,再到信息检索和自动化写作,LLMs正逐渐成为许多领域中不可或缺的工具。然而,随着应用场景的逐渐多样化和需求的不断增加,LLMs推理效率问题日益凸显。在实际应用场景中,快速准确的推理能力对于响应用户请求、处理大规模数据和实时决策至关重要。为了应对这一挑战,学术界展开了广泛的研究和探索,致力于提高LLMs的推理效率。对此,全面调研了实际应用场景中有关LLMs高效推理的文献。首先,介绍了LLMs推理的原理,并分析了在实际应用场景中如何提高LLMs的推理效率。然后,引入了一个针对实际应用场景的分类系统,其主要分为3个层面,分别是算法优化层面、参数优化层面和系统优化层面;并对大模型进行相关研究的总结和归纳。最后,探讨了未来可能的研究方向。

items.title: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
items.title_zh: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
items.summary_zh: 业务流程应变是业务流程管理的重要任务,旨在通过调整流程模型和实例行为来响应不断变化的环境,从而提高其柔韧性并实现业务目标。建模时,残留不确定性导致的长尾变化无法避免,给传统的业务流程应变技术带来了挑战。目前针对长尾变化最有效的应变方法基于一种三方协作框架,即由负责感知长尾变化和提出应变策略的前端业务人员、负责提供服务接口和合规性要求的后端技术人员和管理层,以及辅助应变实施的工具系统共同协作来应对长尾变化,保障业务目标达成。然而,长尾变化在不同时空条件下的多样性、复杂性和应变的迫切性,极有可能超出前端业务人员在应变时对当前情境的理解能力、依据情境制定应变策略的专业水平,以及将应变策略采用领域专用语言有效表达的熟练程度。为弥补这一缺憾并进一步拓展上述框架,提出了一种基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法LLM-Adapt,充分利用大语言模型的泛化能力、强大的内容生成能力,以及嵌入的事件与对策

items.title: 大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验体系架构及技术路径研究
items.title_zh: 大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验体系架构及技术路径研究
items.summary_zh: 战术对抗仿真实验是作战分析、模拟训练和基于仿真的装备活动的核心手段,其智能化、自动化水平直接影响实验效能和战斗力的生成。针对传统仿真实验存在的实验设计、模型构建、导调控制和人机交互效率低等问题,参考MCP协议提出大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验的体系架构。该架构包含基础层、工具资源层、AI Agent层、赋能层、应用层,这5层架构自顶向下牵引,自底向上逐层整合,可实现大小模型与数据资源和传统小模型的耦合聚合,并赋能基于仿真的各项军事活动。在此基础上,重点研究讨论了大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验的具体路径:大模型赋能仿真实验设计,大模型赋能决策模型构建,大模型赋能导调控制。最后,分析了大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验面临的挑战,并给出了相应的应对措施。
